Chroma Cloud stops taking writes on November 22 and reads on December 22 (Chroma's joining Replit). If your RAG or agent memory adds embeddings there, November 22 is your deadline.

Search your code and env files for CloudClient and your Chroma host, then test a re-index.

New paper (RAW-RAG, arxiv 2610.30755): plain retrieval over raw chat history beat elaborate agent memory systems in 6 of 7 settings. Compressing chats into tidy memories breaks the connections answers depend on. Before buying memory infra, ask what the simple baseline scores.

Everyone's bolting graphs onto agent memory. Raw-RAG just windows the raw chat (256 tok), dense-retrieves 128, reranks to 15. Tops 6 of 7 settings. Adding atomic facts or a graph to it cost up to 19 pts. Sometimes coverage is the whole game.

[1/4] 🤯 Many agent memory systems can’t even beat a naive RAG?

We conducted a comprehensive evaluation and find many underperform the naive RAG, even at higher cost.

To better understand this, we introduce “Memory Tax”, see more in our paper.

https://t.co/3St8eM4JvH https://t.co/fK08jZBW5U

Reality check for agent memory: plain RAG over raw chat history (dense retrieval + a reranker) beat fancier memory systems in 6 of 7 benchmark setups.

They also audited Mem0: under 5% of its writes were updates or deletes. Making it append-only raised its LoCoMo score.
